item.title: Bulletin updated at 09:15 HKT 06/Mar/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will persist over Guangdong today and tomorrow. Temperatures will fall progressively over the region. Meanwhile, a broad band of clouds will bring a few rain patches to the coastal areas. The weather will be rather cool over the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week. It will be cold over inland areas. With the monsoon being replaced by an easterly airstream and the band of clouds covering Guangdong gradually thinning out early next week, temperatures will rise progressively and it will be brighter over the region. A maritime airstream is expected to bring humid and foggy weather to the coastal areas midweek next week.
